entries.name: MCP Echo
entries.summary: Minimal local stdio MCP server exposing one echo tool; the reference end-to-end install target for the OpenAR extension hub.

entries.name: Benchmark Stats
entries.summary: Offline statistics for comparing benchmark accuracies: a Wilson interval for one score, an exact McNemar test for two systems on the same items, and how many items a given gap needs.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.summary: Search and inspect models, datasets, Spaces and papers on the Hugging Face Hub through Hugging Face's hosted MCP service; registers a connection, nothing is installed. Works anonymously; signing in is optional.

entries.name: GitMCP
entries.summary: Read and search any public GitHub repository's documentation and code through GitMCP's hosted MCP service, e.g. to check how a paper's released code or a library actually works; registers a connection, nothing is installed. Works anonymously.

entries.name: Calendar
entries.summary: Local research planning: project milestones, shared Todos, deadline points, preparation blocks and reminders.

entries.name: Craft Suite
entries.summary: Choose optional editing components for documents and figures.

entries.name: Deadlines
entries.summary: Track conference and venue deadlines from sources you add, keeping disagreeing dates visible.

entries.name: Deep Research
entries.summary: Run long-form research with your configured provider and read the saved reports.

entries.name: Paper Search
entries.summary: Search papers, keep categorized reading lists and save results into your library.

entries.name: Scientific Compute
entries.summary: Install commit-pinned scientific tools, verify them with their self-tests and run them locally.

entries.name: Context7
entries.summary: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks via Upstash's hosted Context7 MCP service; registers a connection, nothing is installed.
